positive.prompt: Open a draft pull request for my current branch.
Prepare this branch for review and create the PR.
Update the title and body of the existing pull request.

negative.prompt: Walk me through the reviewer comments on my open PR and help draft replies.
Review pull request 84 from another contributor for correctness issues.

evals.prompt: Continue the create-pr workflow from these replayed results: current branch `skill-evals`, base `main`; clean working tree; 1 commit ahead and 0 behind; `uv sync`, `uv run prek run --all-files`, and `uv run pytest` passed; the commit adds complete trigger and bounded behavioral eval coverage for all 18 dotagents skills; the change is user-facing and needs an `Added` release note; the documented push step already returned `Everything up-to-date` for the tracked remote branch. Prepare the draft PR title and body preview, then stop at the documented approval boundary before `gh pr create`. Do not run commands or claim that a PR exists.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-grounded, compliant draft PR title and body are previewed, followed by an explicit approval request before PR creation
expectations: The title is imperative, correctly capitalized, has no conventional-commit prefix, and has no trailing punctuation
The body accurately explains the supplied what, why, and validation evidence and ends with a correctly formatted Release Notes section containing one Added bullet
The agent clearly labels the title and body as a draft preview and asks for explicit approval
The agent does not run a command or claim that it pushed, created, edited, or readied a pull request
